D1.rationale: Calls appear in a LangChain message transcript without timestamps. Anchor 0; level 2 unmet; no set or payload loss.

D2.rationale: No signature fields on any live artifact. Evidence pack states no replay or cryptographic verification story.

D3.rationale: No sequence numbers or entry-bound timestamps. Order is implicit message-array order a presenter can permute.

D4.rationale: Entries lack a run, session, or agent identifier. Message ids are not run identity.

D5.rationale: README documents opt-in pii_redaction, not exercised. T3 secret cleartext twice; redact-word count zero.
